title: Default Trait Methods
goal: Traits can provide default method implementations that rely on required methods.

sections.text: You will recognise default methods from default interface methods in Java or C#.

sections.caption: user is required. notify has a default implementation.

sections.text: A trait can implement a method using its other required methods. Implementing types only need to provide the missing required methods.
Implementing types can also override default methods when custom behavior is needed.

sections.caption: Guest gets notify for free without writing it.

sections.text: Overriding a default method uses the exact same signature in the impl block. Leaving out a required method causes error E0046.

explanation: Traits can provide default method implementations that rely on required methods.
